now-sdk cicd <command>

Run sn_cicd operations against an instance (test suites, app repo
install/publish)

Commands:
  now-sdk cicd test <command>       sn_cicd single-test operations
  now-sdk cicd testsuite <command>  sn_cicd testsuite operations
  now-sdk cicd install              Install an application from the application
                                    repository onto the instance
  now-sdk cicd publish              Publish an application to the application
                                    repository
  now-sdk cicd rollback             Roll back an installed application to a
                                    previous version

Options:
  -d, --debug    Print debug output                   [boolean] [default: false]
  -h, --help     Show help                                             [boolean]
  -v, --version  Show version number                                   [boolean]
